name: match-structured-patterns-test-076cef5d9b/structured-match-patterns-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports [const-pattern](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#const-pattern) and [wildcard-match-pattern](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wildcard-match-pattern)
reason: The negative case requires diagnostics for structured record and tuple match patterns, including nested patterns and unreachable code following exhaustive structured matching. These essential patterns exceed the explicit const/wildcard-only match support.
unsupported_constructs: Record binding match patterns such as var {s, i: integer} and nested var [a, b, {s, i}]
Tuple/list binding match patterns such as var [a, b, c]
test_design_notes: The @error markers assert rejection diagnostics; unsupported structured patterns remain essential even though some string constant patterns are supported.
